_meta.purpose: Khajistan TV programming — show catalogue, weekly grid, dated month.
_meta.clock: One station clock: Pakistan Standard Time, UTC+5, no daylight saving. The stream runs continuously; a slot names the hour a show starts, and a set tuning in joins whatever is on wherever it has got to.

channels.name: Channel 1 · Bioscope
channels.line: Feature films: Pakistani and Pashto cinema, off tape, disc and print and from the archive's holdings.

channels.name: Channel 2 · Drama
channels.line: PTV drama, serials at nine every night, and The Break between programmes.

channels.name: Channel 3 · Lost Lollywood
channels.line: Lost Lollywood Soundtracks, whole films' music end to end. Sound with no picture.

channels.name: Channel 4 · Family Tapes
channels.line: Weddings from family collections: the baraat, mehndi, mayun, nikah and walima, and Band Baja, the wedding brass bands, at six.

channels.name: Channel 13 · Khajistan Radio
channels.line: Omar Ali Khan's radio shows and the region's records: Mondo Bizarro at nine, Saturday Street before Christmas, Punjab Side, The Voice, Baghdad, Kabul & Herat.

mondo-bizarro.name: Mondo Bizarro
mondo-bizarro.line: Omar Ali Khan's own show. Lollywood club, desi funk, Dracula in Pakistan, the pakoras.

saturday-street.name: Saturday Street
saturday-street.line: Christmas in Garhi Shahu. Whatever the street was playing.

strange-archive.name: Strange Archive
strange-archive.line: Juntar muntar, parts of body, and the records on no other shelf.

hi-tea.name: Hi Tea
hi-tea.line: The afternoon record. Mummy daddy, daddy ka shukriya.

prime-signal.name: Prime Signal
prime-signal.line: The PIA mix. The airline had its own orchestra.

archive-program.name: Archive Program
archive-program.line: Khorasan, Mashriq–Maghreb, Shabbat, Ramzan. Four mixes, a region each.

jihadi-jams.name: Jihadi Jams
jihadi-jams.line: Nasheeds, and a few talks. From the blog The Few, The Proud, The Mujahideen, nearly all Arabic: Gaza and Iraq, Eid and Ramadan. From toorabora.info, Al Haj Faqeer Mohammad Darwesh and Mohammad Amin Hedaree. A Pashto set off the Internet Archive.

lollywood-soundtracks.name: Lost Lollywood Soundtracks
lollywood-soundtracks.line: The music of 469 Pakistani films, cut from Khajistan's own film holdings. Whole soundtracks, end to end.

mehfil-3.name: Mehfil on Record
mehfil-3.line: The evening concert with no picture. A sitting-room recording, a stage night.

kabul-and-herat-3.name: Kabul & Herat
kabul-and-herat-3.line: Afghan song in Dari and Pashto, off the record. Ghazal, tappa, the wedding band.

baghdad-3.name: Baghdad
baghdad-3.line: Iraqi and Levantine song without a picture — the mawal, the choubi.

the-break.name: The Break
the-break.line: Video-company logos, cassette-label stings, the odd cigarette advert. Between programmes.

jordan-television.name: Jordan Television
jordan-television.line: The Jordanian state channel's own evenings, mostly from the 1990s.

nirt-variety.name: NIRT Variety
nirt-variety.line: Iranian television variety of the 1970s: the Rangarang run, the Cafe Show, Farrokhzad, Studio 11, Cheshmak.

someones-wedding.name: Someone's Wedding
someones-wedding.line: Baraats, mehndis, birthdays, the family camcorder. Nobody made these to be broadcast.

coming-attractions.name: Coming Attractions
coming-attractions.line: Trailers, run as a reel. The Filmfarsi volumes and the Hi-Tech Films promos.

ptv.name: PTV
ptv.line: The state broadcaster's drama, off DVD transfers, in disc-and-part order.

iranian-documentary.name: Iranian Documentary
iranian-documentary.line: Iranian documentary film from the 1930s to the 1990s, with one short fiction film, one animation and a recorded 1970 theatre discussion.

filmfarsi.name: Filmfarsi
filmfarsi.line: Pre-revolution Iranian cinema and the colour restorations.

the-feature.name: The Feature
the-feature.line: The full picture. Lollywood, Pashto cinema, whatever the print we hold will carry.

mehfil-on-tape.name: Mehfil on Tape
mehfil-on-tape.line: The evening concert as somebody's cassette caught it. A sitting-room mehfil, a stage night.

the-voice.name: The Voice
the-voice.line: The woman's voice carrying the popular song, from Lahore to Kabul.

tape-feature.name: The Tape Feature
tape-feature.line: The film as it reached a living room. A rental cassette, end to end, tracking as it was.

folk-tv.name: Folk
folk-tv.line: Folk singers of the Indus and the Pashto belt.

stage-tv.name: Mujra
stage-tv.line: Mujra and stage dance from Punjab's theatres and functions.

kawleeya.name: Kawleeya
kawleeya.line: Iraqi kawleeya, the hair dance of the gypsy parties, off VHS.

devotional-tv.name: Naat
devotional-tv.line: Naat, hamd, manqabat, majlis, bayan and dua, sung, recited and played.

qawwali.name: Qawwali
qawwali.line: Qawwali parties, on record and on tape.

ghazal.name: Ghazal
ghazal.line: The ghazal and the sung nazm, at a sitting and off the cassette.

mela.name: Folk Dance
mela.line: Attan, jhumar and the dancing at the country fair.

mela-sport.name: Mela
mela-sport.line: Kabaddi, horse riding and neza bazi at the country fair.

essakhailvi.name: Attaullah Khan Essakhailvi
essakhailvi.line: Attaullah Khan Essakhailvi's dohre and mahiye, off the cassette volumes.

bandial.name: Muhammad Hussain Bandial
bandial.line: Muhammad Hussain Bandial's songs, off the numbered cassette volumes, with a stage show and a television programme.

beyond-the-rivers.name: Beyond the Five Rivers
beyond-the-rivers.line: Folk, naat and the evening concert from the Arab world, Egypt, Afghanistan and Iran.

khwajasira-tv.name: Khwajasira
khwajasira-tv.line: Rites, functions and music videos, made by the community.

band-baja.name: Band Baja
band-baja.line: Brass bands at weddings, urs and processions, from the bands' own videos.

lollywood-dialogues.name: Lollywood Dialogues
lollywood-dialogues.line: Lines cut from Lollywood films by Omar Ali Khan for Khajistan Radio.

pop-tv.name: Pop
pop-tv.line: Pop and dabke, on video and off the cassette.

interviews-tv.name: Interviews & Documentary
interviews-tv.line: Interviews, documentaries, reports and village footage from Pothwar.

tv-tapings-tv.name: Antenna — Mixed
tv-tapings-tv.line: Off-air recordings with mixed or unconfirmed country of origin.

tehrangeles-tv.name: Tehrangeles
tehrangeles-tv.line: Jaam-e Jam TV, Los Angeles National Television, the Tanin, Taraneh and Tapesh shows, and Golha-ye Europa, "the first Iranian TV show in Europe".

postrev-cinema.name: Post-Revolution Cinema
postrev-cinema.line: Iranian films off VCD, DVD and digital copies.

amrc.name: Afghan Media Resource Center
amrc.line: Tapes from the AMRC's Afghan camera crews, its Peshawar office and its off-air recorder.

home-movies.name: Home Movies
home-movies.line: Birthdays, children growing up, school days, trips north and the village, off the family camcorder.

mondo-bizarro-night.name: Mondo Bizarro
mondo-bizarro-night.line: Omar Ali Khan's own show: Dracula in Pakistan, built around Zinda Laash.

punjab-side-3.name: Punjab Side
punjab-side-3.line: Punjabi and Saraiki folk as the cassette labels cut it. Dohra, mahiya, vol. 17 of somebody's best.

drama-at-nine.name: Drama at Nine
drama-at-nine.line: PTV serials at nine, part after part in the order we hold them.

friday-night-feature.name: Friday Night Feature
friday-night-feature.line: A feature every Friday night, a different one each week.

sunday-tape-matinee.name: Sunday Tape Matinee
sunday-tape-matinee.line: A rental cassette at noon on Sunday, tracking as it was.

jumeraat-qawwali.name: Jumeraat Qawwali
jumeraat-qawwali.line: Thursday night, when qawwali is sung at the shrines.

ajmer-urs.name: The Ajmer Urs
ajmer-urs.line: Qawwali for the urs of Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti, on the night of 6 Rajab.

shab-e-yalda.name: Shab-e Yalda
shab-e-yalda.line: Filmfarsi through the longest night of the year.

noor-jehan.name: Noor Jehan
noor-jehan.line: Films she sang for, on the anniversary of her death, 23 December 2000.

christmas-special.name: Christmas in Garhi Shahu
christmas-special.line: All three of Saturday Street's Garhi Shahu Christmas mixes, on Christmas night.

new-years-night.name: New Year's Night
new-years-night.line: Kawleeya and folk dance across midnight.

googoosh.name: Googoosh on Wednesday
googoosh.line: A Rangarang evening with Googoosh, every Wednesday.

pakistani-pop.name: Pakistani Pop
pakistani-pop.line: Pop from Pakistan, every Tuesday night.

shaadi-night.name: Shaadi Night
shaadi-night.line: Baraat, mehndi and walima tapes on Saturday night, in the wedding season.
